## blowhorn store

Report whether this computer can use Blowhorn, and say why not when it cannot: signed in, a client the server still accepts, and a member of the organization. `--replay-spool` also drains the results already waiting in the local write-back spool; apart from it, nothing here writes anything.

Exits 0 when the store is usable and 3 when it is not -- the same code every other command uses for an unreachable store, so a wrapper can tell an outage from a failed job. `--json` emits the check as one object: ok, exitCode, cause, error, organization, reachable, spoolDepth, warnings, rungs, replay and cloud; configured is always true, and configPath, configMode, dsn, tunnel, serverVersion, schema and validation are always null.

```text
blowhorn store [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit the check as machine-readable JSON (the shape the desktop app's Setup row reads) |
| `--replay-spool` | boolean | `false` | Write out the results waiting in the local write-back spool now, rather than leaving them for the next run to drain, and report how many write-backs were pushed, kept and dropped. An entry whose activity no longer exists is named and dropped from the pending file (the month's ledger still holds it); nothing else is ever deleted. With `--dry-run` it writes nothing and reports what the run without it would have done |
| `--platform` | string |  | Accepted and ignored by `blowhorn store`: this command never acts on a platform, so `--platform` has no effect here -- including a value inherited from `BLOWHORN_PLATFORM` or defaults.platform in .blowhorn.yaml |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn store` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn store` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn store
blowhorn store --json
blowhorn store --replay-spool
blowhorn store --replay-spool --dry-run
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
